title: Fauci’s Modern Pillory
gist: Buruma reads the Senate Homeland Security Committee hearing that subjected Anthony Fauci to gratuitous attacks as an attack not on science itself but on the expert class that advises lawmakers — a televised pillorying meant to discredit any public-facing expert.

insights.claim: The MAGA Republican campaign against Anthony Fauci is driven less by hatred of science than by disdain for the scientists who guide lawmakers' decision-making.
insights.speaker: IAN BURUMA
insights.so_what: Reframes the political risk: the target is advisory authority inside government, which bears on agency staffing, regulatory science, and FDA/NIH policy credibility.
insights.quote: less about their hatred of science and more about their disdain for the scientists who guide lawmakers in their decision-making
insights.locator: MAGA Republicans’ decision to drag Anthony Fauci

insights.claim: The hearing functioned as a public spectacle intended to pillory Fauci and, by association, any public-facing expert in front of the cameras.
insights.speaker: IAN BURUMA
entities: US Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
insights.so_what: Signals rising personal cost of public advisory roles — expect recruitment and retention difficulties at US scientific agencies.
insights.quote: They couldn’t wait to pillory him, and by association any public-facing expert, in front of the cameras.
insights.locator: MAGA Republicans’ decision to drag Anthony Fauci

insights.claim: Fauci directed the US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases from 1984 to 2022, served as chief medical adviser to the President in 2021-22, was instrumental in developing HIV/AIDS treatments, and led America's COVID-19 response.
insights.speaker: IAN BURUMA
entities: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
insights.so_what: The record establishes that seniority and track record provide no political protection — a marker of how far institutional norms around expertise have shifted.
insights.locator: NEW YORK—Anthony Fauci has had a long and distinguished career
